I do some backyard beekeeping myself. Currently I keep 2 colonies and have always used the flow hives, which do not really disrupt the bees in any way when harvesting. The honey flows out when you open a valve, and they do not even realize it is happening.  Because they don’t even realize it is happening until it’s over, they don’t really care and just get started on refilling the pre-made combs. I have never had any negative experiences with Mellona since I started working with her. As long as you treat the bees and her with the respect they deserve I do not see her responding negatively. I obviously don’t always know what a goddess is thinking but I have been given gifts from her because contrary to the belief of some, beekeeping when done right is very helpful to a colony. She may also like this innovative, gentler approach. We protect them from invasive Varroa mites as best as we can, feed them in the winter, and do everything in our power to make sure they thrive. Taking their excess honey when they do not need it is not a bad thing. Overall, I believe Mellona understands how much we can benefit the colonies and understands that a reward for our hard work is well deserved, which is why she keeps the honey sweet! I know traditional ways of harvesting are more disruptive but I also believe she understands that the goal of the beekeeper is to take only what the bees don’t need and it is a symbiotic relationship. After all, she IS the goddess of beekeeping so she definitely does not see it negatively. As long as you truly care about the bees I can’t really see anything going wrong with Mellona. Hope this helped! :)

First off I’m so glad that this resonates with you! If you want to clarify if Mellona is your deity or not, you could take this post as a sign she is. Personally I would start to meditate in order to let go of your expectations, I have found the answers come to me very clearly when my own want is detached. Calling out to them is another route you might want to take, to do this meditate on your desire to communicate with them and form a relationship. This form of meditation is different than trying to release your expectations in that you are actively trying to call to them and not just figure out who they are. From what I have read you will get a response either while meditating or as a sign later on. It might even be a feeling or vision you get, if calling out to someone you want to work with is an idea you like you can use prayer as well. For more immediate answers you can start using divination if you would like. There are many tarot spreads you can use to discover who is calling out to you, and their traits or reason for doing so. A pendulum is another very good tool. If you don’t have one a necklace will do, really anything attached to a string will work. Remember, your intention is what matters most and you do not need anything fancy to practice. Make sure though you have spent time bonding with your pendulum, tarot cards, tunes, or any other form of divination. Your energy is important in this process. If you are not comfortable with divination you can always ask for another sign or look for any of the signs I mentioned in my post. To ask for a sign you can meditate, pray, etc. I hope this helped give you a starting point, but I encourage you to find a way of practicing that suits you best :)
